intro: Tallow is a Forsaken warrior stationed in the fortified settlement of Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. Serving the Dark Lady and the Horde, he watches over the contested front lines, helping organize strikes against local Alliance threats.

p: Situated in the heart of Tarren Mill, Tallow stands among the Forsaken and Horde forces holding the line in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The region is a powder keg of conflict, caught between nearby Southshore humans, wandering Syndicate outlaws, and hostile wildlife. Tallow helps direct capable adventurers into the field, testing their strength against the Boulderfist ogres of the Arathi Highlands before sending them on to aid the besieged outpost of Hammerfall.
